motivation.body: Mothership OS is the first governance system to explicitly utilize Role-Based Reasoning Sinks driven by Substrate Telemetry ($St$) and Cognitive Provenance ($Cp$). This creates a closed-loop alignment between planned architectural intent, observed execution, and the human creative cycle, ensuring the AI command plane is anchored to physical reality.

claims.title: ⚓ NOVELTY CLAIMS
claims.c1: Isolation of Reasoning: The first system to logically separate Architect, Engineer, and Sentinel into discrete Role-Based Reasoning Sinks.
claims.c2: Telemetry-Driven Alignment: The first to utilize real-time Substrate Telemetry ($St$) to inform and refine Elder specialization tracks.
claims.c3: Physical Residency Anchor: The first to enforce mandatory physical residency for AI-governed documents to prevent prompt-injection and context-drift.
claims.c4: Chrono-Cognitive Ingestion: The first system to utilize Human Temporal Measurement to anchor Intellectual Property to specific human neuro-performance states.
claims.c5: Relational Accountability: The first to bind the Sovereign Director to the legal interests of the Business Entity through KMS-signed ethical gates.
claims.c6: Spatial Integrity Latch: The first to implement a local-first Mothership Bridge that verifies absolute file paths to prevent Spatial Blindness and Ghost Root hallucinations.
